implementation_map.classification: authored bounded measurement method, not a quoted new equation from either guide

adaptations: Planar rigid primitives are matched to local isometric machinery, separate from world-map travel and tactical hex authority.
VREX uses its retained RK4 core; the downstream mechanism uses symplectic Euler at 1/256 model time.
Body damping splits actual removed kinetic energy into terminal useful work and heat.
Mechanical tolerance is 1 percent; retained VREX tolerance is 1e-6.
Pump and press resource/work thresholds, efficiencies and fatigue rules are authored dimensionless game approximations.
limits: No full 3D rigid-body solver, convex-mesh manifolds, exact continuous collision detection, fluid field, fracture or cloth implementation.
Adaptive displacement substeps reject over-budget motion before stepping; they are not an all-speed CCD guarantee.
No physical-unit, quantum or experimental calibration.
Cross-correlation reports association with explicit lag sign; it does not establish causality or energy generation.
